articles.title: Could You Fit 2 Million Hot Dogs Inside a Giant Sculpture? We Did the Math!
articles.summary: A 65-foot-long hot dog sculpture is back in NYC. We calculated that about 1.75 million real hot dogs could squeeze inside—if you ignore the messy gaps!

articles.title: NASA's New Moon Mission Will Teach Spaceships to Dance Together in Orbit!
articles.summary: NASA's CAPSTONE 02 mission will send two small spacecraft to the Moon in 2027. They'll practice tricky moves like chasing and flying in formation to help future astronauts dock safely.

articles.title: Dinosaurs in Space? Star Trek's New Season Has Scary Ghosts and Puppet Trouble Too!
articles.summary: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds Season 4 just launched with dinosaurs, a haunted starship, and a noir mystery. Showrunners say it's their best season yet.
